Please review carefully, edit if needed, and only generate when you are satisfied with the rewritten prompt.

Discovers foundation, custom, and imported models, and fetches pricing.

Makes multiple API calls — may take 30-60 seconds.
model_settings.sync_detail_full:
This discovers foundation, custom, and imported models, and fetches pricing data.

Makes multiple AWS API calls — may take 30–60 seconds.

Run this only when:
• Setting up for the first time
• AWS has released new models
• You’ve created or imported custom models
• You need updated pricing

custom_models.subtitle: Self-hosted models on Amazon SageMaker in your AWS account.
custom_models.deploy_type_desc: On-Demand (recommended): Scales to zero when idle. Always-On: No cold start but costs continuously.
custom_models.remove_confirm: This will delete the Amazon SageMaker endpoint and any stored HuggingFace tokens. The model can be redeployed later.
custom_models.hf_desc: This model is gated on HuggingFace. To deploy it:
custom_models.hf_step1: Visit the model page and accept the license
custom_models.hf_step2: Go to huggingface.co/settings/tokens → create a Read-only token
custom_models.hf_warning: A Read-only token is sufficient. Your token is stored encrypted in AWS Secrets Manager in your account and reused for all gated models. You can manage it via the 🔑 HF Token button.
custom_models.add_model_desc: Enter a HuggingFace model URL or repo ID. The system will auto-detect the model type, library, and requirements.
custom_models.add_model_gated: This repo may be gated. Provide a Read-only HuggingFace token if needed (stored encrypted in your AWS account):
custom_models.no_models: No custom models available in the catalog.
custom_models.description_line: Self-hosted models that run on Amazon SageMaker in your AWS account. Deploy to use alongside Amazon Bedrock models.
custom_models.cold_start_warning: Self-hosted model — first request may take 5-15 min if the endpoint is waking up from idle (cold start). Subsequent requests are fast.
custom_models.delete_token_confirm: Delete the shared HuggingFace token? Gated models will fail on next cold start without it.
custom_models.async_submitted_hint: Image will appear in Pending Jobs when ready. You can continue working.
custom_models.async_no_jobs: No async jobs yet. Self-hosted models generate images in the background.
custom_models.async_footer: Self-hosted models generate asynchronously. Images appear in the Gallery when complete. Stale or unfinished jobs are automatically cleaned up after 24 hours — either while the app is running, or on next startup.
